title: Supply Line Crisis
description: Aberdeen's warehouses are empty and the goblins have owned the north road for weeks. Break the blockade, or find the smugglers' path through the swamp nobody has walked since. Then tell Larton that Aberdeen can still take a shipment.

objectives.description: Hear Bjorn's numbers - what's left in Aberdeen's warehouses, and how long
Investigate the blocked trade route near Kazer-Dun
Clear the goblin blockade OR find the hidden swamp path to Larton

choices.description: Defeat the goblin scouts blocking the road
Discover the old smuggler's route through the swamp

objectives.description: Reach Larton and tell the Trade Master Aberdeen can take a shipment

notes: Threat: Aberdeen's warehouses already empty. Giver motive: Bjorn acting on Aberdeen's own initiative rather than waiting on Larton's relief effort (see aberdeen_relief, starving_south). The swamp path here and the route aberdeen_relief marks afterward are the same problem attacked from opposite ends - read as one regional crisis across four quests, four desks (starving_south, retake_harbor, supply_line_crisis, aberdeen_relief). The choice objective allows players to either fight through or find a sneaky alternative; data unchanged.
